<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a11faeecb34eb14800d64769cb86a8e1140988f1` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9efd8ffa5d2cc9b22270f1c86f9f18c5d9d1c25b`
Local-runs: none

Reviewed as an isolated subagent of the dispatching seat, from these inputs and nothing else: the card (#20960, body and all four comments: triage 5923800404, claim 5924978148, the devx seat's `description` pointer 5925333725, the os-dev-report 5927689393), the PR body, its four-file list, the net diff at the head, and the head's check-runs. Files were read at the head through `git show` and objectui through the contents API. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set or public-surface change the diff implies, named right or wrong.

1. **`DashboardWidgetOptionsSchema` accept set, unchanged. Right.** The diff in `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` replaces lines of the leading doc comment only; the `z.object({ dateGranularity, sortBy, sortOrder, limit, stageOrder }).passthrough().describe(...)` expression at head `:253` to `:308` is byte-identical. No key is declared, no value is typed, the catchall stays open. The claim's `Clause-②: yes` was conditional on the census declaring a key; the census declared none, so the measured arm `no` is the right one.
2. **Shipped bytes: the doc comment ships, so a changeset is owed. Right.** The JSDoc on the exported const is carried into `dist/ui/index.d.ts`. The `.describe()` text is untouched, so the generated reference page under `content/docs/references/` does not move. The dev reports `check:generated` and `check:docs` green; CI confirms them in Lint & Repo Gates, which was still in progress at read time (check-run reading below).
3. **Census, writers. Right, and complete.** At the head the only dashboard producers that wrote through the bag were app-crm `pipeline.dashboard.ts` (`format`, `currency` on three metric tiles) and app-todo `task.dashboard.ts` (`color` on four tiles, `suffix`, `showLegend` twice, `horizontal`, `showDataLabels`). Checked against every other producer at the head: app-showcase's three dashboards carry no widget `options` (the `options:` arrays at `ops-dashboard.dashboard.ts:72` and `revenue-pulse.dashboard.ts:45` are filter select options, a different shape); `platform-objects` `system_overview.dashboard.ts`, the `create-objectstack` blank template and the Studio create seed (`kernel/metadata-create-seeds.ts`) write none. The dev's reading of the writers at `2821e9f15` matches the head.
4. **Census, readers. Right.** objectui `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` at `main` `5262f7dd` reads exactly `options.dateGranularity`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `limit`, `stageOrder` (`:541` to `:551`, `:1785`) and `options.description` (`:1118`); the objectui pin `e420df310` (this repo's `.objectui-sha`) reads the same six and nothing else. `DashboardRenderer.tsx` (`datasetBound = !!widget.dataset` at `:647`, dispatch at `:1035`) and `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` (`:583`, `:649`) both route a widget with a `dataset` to `DatasetWidget`, and the spec requires `dataset` (`dashboard.zod.ts:1176`, not optional). So the inline arm's `...options` spread (`DashboardRenderer.tsx:814`, `:832`, `:863`, `:929`), the only place `format`, `currency` or `suffix` would be seen, is unreachable for a spec-valid widget. The metric tile formats from the measure (`formatMeasure(value, f?.format, f?.currency, ...)` at `:1126`, with `f = measureField(values[0])` at `:1043`), takes its accent from `widget.colorVariant` (`:1071`) and its legend from `widget.chartConfig` (`:1800`).
5. **Verdict per written key: written, unread, removed from the producer. Right under the card's rule and ADR-0049.** app-crm loses nothing visible: `opportunity.dataset.ts:32` to `:33` already declare `format: '0,0', currency: 'USD'` on `total_amount` and `avg_amount`. app-todo's removed keys never rendered; the dev did not migrate them to their declared homes (`chartConfig.showDataLabels`, `type: 'horizontal-bar'`, `colorVariant`) because that would change what the example renders, which the card did not ask for. Both examples are `private: true` and publish nothing, so the removals change no accept set and owe no changeset. No test in either example pinned the removed keys (grep at the head: none).
6. **Verdict for `description`: read, no authored writer, not declared. Right.** The only writer is the spec's own `translateDashboard` (`system/i18n-resolver.ts:1537` to `:1540`), which overlays a bundle `subCaption` entry onto `options.description` server-side; that is a different authored key on the i18n bundle, not a producer writing `options.description`, and this repo ships no such entry. The devx seat's pointer (5925333725) measured no producer in either repo and pointed to the reader dropping it; objectui#11228 ruling C keeps the key refused by name. Declaring it here would contradict that ruling, so leaving it undeclared and naming the read drop as objectui's follow-up is the right arm. `CONSUMED_WIDGET_OPTION_KEYS` in `@objectstack/sdui-parser` keeps its six members and `scripts/check-widget-option-census.mjs` already states this asymmetry in its own header, so nothing in the parser moves.
7. **The doc comment's claims, each checked against the inputs. Right.** "dataset is required" (item 4), "reads exactly the five keys plus description" (item 4), "only the legacy inline arm spreads the bag" (item 4), "translateDashboard overlays from a subCaption bundle entry" (item 6), "declared homes: measure format and currency, colorVariant, chartConfig" (item 4). The comment cites `#20960`, `objectui#11228` and objectui `5262f7dd`: the card, the ruling and the commit the census was read at.
8. **No other derived surface moves.** No `.strict()` or `retiredKey()` tombstone is added or removed, no liveness-ledger row changes (the bag's undeclared keys never had one), no ADR-0087 entry is owed (② below), and no `content/docs/**` or `skills/**` path is in the diff.
9. **The dev's H4 scratch replica of objectui's strict-face walker is not relied on here.** It is a probe the dev ran, not a gate and not objectui's own face; the card's acceptance item 3 asks the closer to link the real objectui run, and that stays owed by the closer. Judged on the inputs alone: app-crm's pipeline dashboard now carries no `options` key at all, so nothing is left there for a closed catchall to refuse.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/20960-widget-options-census.md` declares `'@objectstack/spec': patch` with `Clause-②: no` and no `(widening)` or `(narrowing)` arm. That matches what the diff publishes: a doc-comment change in a shipped `.d.ts`, an unchanged accept set, and two private examples. `skip-changeset` would be wrong because `@objectstack/spec` ships the comment; `minor` would be wrong because nothing is declared or widened. The repo's precedent for exactly this class has the same shape (`19518-picklist-wording.md`, `20726-toggle-door-docs-spec.md`, `20809-guidance-slot-docblocks.md`: all `docs(spec)` at `patch` with `Clause-②: no`). The changeset body carries the PR's `Clause-②` line as AGENTS.md step 3 requires; a non-breaking patch owes no ADR-0087 disposition marker (the dev's `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0; CI's Check Changeset is success). The `Clause-②: no` line in the PR body is the measured arm the claim left to the census, and it is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions` is empty. Every flag the dev raised (deviations and out-of-scope findings in report 5927689393, plus the PR's acceptance notes) and every pointer on the card, answered or escalated:

- **Landing site: no declarations.** Answered, right (① items 1, 5, 6).
- **Changeset `patch` with `Clause-②: no` against the claim's anticipated `minor`.** Answered, right (②).
- **`examples/app-todo/src/dashboards/task.dashboard.ts` in the diff.** Inside the claim's surface ("producers under `examples/**`, only where the verdict is written but unread"); the census found it next to app-crm. In surface.
- **`origin/main` merged through `os-regen-merge.sh` before `pr_create`.** The API's file list is the four files; the net diff carries nothing else. Fine.
- **H4 measured with a scratch replica, not objectui's own face.** Answered in ① item 9; the real-run link is the closer's (card acceptance item 3), not this record's.
- **Devx seat pointer 5925333725 on `description`.** Answered in ① item 6: one census row, read but unwritten, not declared; the reader-side drop is objectui's follow-up. Escalated to the seat as a note for that follow-up: the strict face refusing `options.description` by name and `translateDashboard` writing it onto a served document are then at odds on the served path, which objectui's drop must settle (drop the read and the overlay target together, or exempt the served path).
- **Out-of-scope finding: `checkDashboardWidgetOptions` has one caller (`sdui-parser/src/validate.ts:318`, SDUI page nodes only), so a `*.dashboard.ts` carrying an unread `options` key is silent at `os validate`.** Confirmed at the head (that is the single non-test caller). Escalated to the seat: a card in this family (class c, named producer) if none exists; not this PR's.
- **Out-of-scope finding: teaching surfaces still say the renderer understands presentation extras.** `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx:138` to `:139` ("keys the renderer understands (`icon`, `columns`, `striped`, `density`, ...) pass through untouched"), `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:185` (`options: { icon: 'DollarSign' }`) and `:341`. The shipped doc comment now says the opposite, and this review's reading of objectui agrees with the comment. Neither page is in the diff and both were already wrong at `main`; the skill is `skills/**`, Tier H under Prime Directive #14, so the dev was right to leave it. Escalated to the seat: a docs-only follow-up for `dashboards.mdx` and a maintainer-tier edit for the skill, routed with this card's family. Not blocking this record: the PR introduces no new drift, and the Docs Drift Check on the PR (5927664256) says itself that `dashboard.zod.ts` yielded no anchor, so this hand re-read is the coverage it asks for.
- **Noted, not filed** (the app-todo completion_rate tile titled "Completion Rate" but rendering `task_count`; the stale `categoryGranularity` sentence in `pipeline.dashboard.ts`'s header comment; declared homes not used; `.describe()` kept; no shared ISO 4217 schema in `packages/spec`). None is a contract matter. Keeping `.describe()` is right: `@objectstack/sdui-parser` and objectui quote it in lockstep, so rewording it is a cross-repo edit this card did not claim. The three spellings of `z.string().length(3)` are a spec hygiene finding the seat can card if wanted.
- **Card acceptance item 1 ("the census table is on this card").** The table is in the PR body; the card carries the report's prose summary of every row. Escalated to the seat: copy the table or its link onto the card at close, together with the objectui run link acceptance item 3 asks for.

None failed as read. The seat re-reads every run before landing; a run still in progress is not a FAIL here, and Lint & Repo Gates is the one that carries `check:generated`, `check:docs` and `check:widget-option-census`, which ② and ① item 2 lean on.
